errors.text_span: 水平轴显示有关新冠报道数量
errors.evidence: The horizontal axis (X-axis) represents dates, not COVID-19 news report quantities.

errors.text_span: 另一侧的柱显示相关 covid-19 新闻报道数量范围从0到6000
errors.evidence: The right vertical axis represents COVID-19 news report quantities, not '另一侧的柱'. The description confuses the axis with the visual elements.
The description does not explicitly state the chart's purpose of showing the trends between daily new COVID-19 cases and related news reports.
The description does not mention the weekly interval labeling on the X-axis.
The description does not mention the step size of 200,000 for the left Y-axis.
The description does not mention the step size of 1,000 for the right Y-axis.
The description does not mention the blue-green color of the bars representing daily new COVID-19 cases.
The description does not mention the blue color of the line representing COVID-19-related news report quantities.
The description does not mention the synchronization trend between the two datasets during most time periods.
The description does not mention the peak differences, such as the lag effect between case peaks and news report increases.

errors.text_span: 视觉提醒我们，柱形图的纵向高度分别表示每个类别在特定时间每天的数量。
errors.evidence: The sentence is overly verbose and unclear, making it difficult to understand the intended meaning.
